_comment: tech_hard_target panel 0 'Hanging from matched jugs, one foot laser-taps a foothold'. Woman on a 30 deg overhang. Both hands matched on one large jug J (size 1.6, hands at x -0.06/+0.06), arms straight (elbows ~171 deg; the 5.8 cm scapular shift is the tool's price for a straight arm). Body hangs PLUMB under the grip: pelvis pitch 30 = torso world-vertical, hip joint 71 cm from the wall surface (82 cm horizontally to the wall at hip height); 40-60 cm is not reachable with a plumb hang on 30 deg for a 1.66 m figure, so plumb + clear gap was kept. RIGHT leg raised forward: thigh ~3 deg below horizontal, knee ~154 deg pointing up (kneecap on top), shin ~25 deg down to F1; only the toe tip (shoe level, pointed foot, ankle ~61 deg) touches the top of F1 (the PURPLE chip, x +0.18, ~28 cm below the hip joint = between hip and mid-thigh), heel in the air. LEFT leg hangs straight (knee ~169 deg) on the plumb line, toes down, touching nothing. Head turned slightly right and down, looking at the right toe. Six more green chips F2-F7 spread at x -0.42..+0.50 between hip height and ~mid-thigh height (next targets). Narrow wall panel (1.5 x 3.2 m, no floor) on navy #1F2633 for compositing. Camera: side-rear from the climber's right, az 62 (28 deg off the wall plane), lens at hip height (camera world height 1.31 = hip), figure centred, ~86% of frame height. v3 (coach fixes): F4 deleted (it sat behind the right heel in the main view); F6 moved to (0.45,1.31), inside the hip..mid-thigh band and within the leg's reach. Optional shrug fix NOT applied: raising the pelvis 5.5 cm removes the 5.8 cm shoulder shift but the tool then caps the elbows at 160 deg (visibly bent arms, a listed wrong version); the shrug is handled in the prompt instead. v4: in the main view F7 (-0.42,1.466) sat 14 px from the shin line right past the kneecap (read as the shin/knee resting on a hold) and F2 (-0.10,1.373) 20 px above the shin; moved F7 to (0.62,1.48) and F2 to (0.175,1.44), both inside the hip..mid-thigh band (world 1.28 / 1.25 m), within reach (0.96 / 0.83 m from the right hip), >=44 px from every other hold and >=58 px from the legs in the main view. v5: panel narrowed to x -0.35..+0.80 (was -0.70..+0.80) so that in the main view its far edge no longer grazes the chest: more navy between the hanging body and the wall.
